correctness.rationale: This PASS is for the corrected RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt in repairs/2, not the frozen claim that all three coordinate supports are mutually exclusive. The frozen table itself refutes that claim: each long-arm coordinate has mass 1/4 at BOTH +1 and −1. The replacement correctly says the two ±1 eigenspaces are orthogonal but have identical coordinate support, disjoint from the 0-eigenspace support. To reconstruct the corrected theorem, bounded degree gives bounded selfadjoint adjacency, and the leaf equations force every root amplitude to vanish at 0. Then the long arms vanish and the two short leaves sum to zero. At each of ±1 the equations λz=u and λu=x+z imply x=0, so the short leaves vanish, z=λu, and the root equation forces the two u's to sum to zero. These pointwise constraints are necessary and sufficient for all square-summable eigenvectors. Normalizing the two-entry or four-entry local generators gives masses 1/2 or 1/4; the disjoint supports of 0 and +1 already suffice to obstruct dominance for every vertex. A ray has vertices of degree 2, hence the decorated maximum degree is exactly six, and finite pendant trees add no ends. The attached finite rational checker was reviewed as supplementary and not executed.
